accrueBody: The weekly aggregate starts accruing now (42% approve / 56% disapprove as of Jun 29, 2026). A sourced cross-president comparison (prior presidents at the same point in term) is planned as a one-time historical import, clearly labelled as survey data.
channels: public opinion responds to everything on this board — it is the electorate’s own scoreboard, not a government statistic.
limits: poll aggregates smooth single-poll noise but inherit house effects and modelling choices; this is the board’s one survey-derived metric, labelled as such.
caveats: VoteHub’s public feed has carried no new national approval poll since Jun 29, 2026 — the figure shown is the last aggregate. The pipeline checks daily; this card revives automatically when polls resume.
Simple average of recent national polls, one per pollster (VoteHub, CC-BY); the poll list is linked from the source. Opinion data, not a government statistic.
